description:
Count entries under every starting letter of one RS3 catalogue category, to choose nonempty groups before browse_items. Use lookup_item for name search.
- Get category from get_all_categories. It selects one catalogue group, not an item or starting letter: 24 means high-level melee weapons, and 0 is one Miscellaneous group. There is no all-categories sentinel; query each desired ID separately.
- One call returns all alpha letters with item counts; no per-letter argument is needed. # denotes numeric names. These count distinct catalogue entries, not stock or available offers.
- Each call makes one public Jagex request without auth or a local cache. Jagex controls snapshot freshness; upstream failures return tool errors. HTTP shares 60 requests/IP/minute by default; honor Retry-After on 429.
name: get_category_info

items.description: Number of catalogue items in this letter group
